name: Soul Bull Armored
description: The Winterworks Soul Bull: a hulking bull skeleton kept alive by soul fire. Charred wither-grey bones, thick and cracked; massive shoulder blades and a hump of spined vertebrae; broken ribs round a ribcage roaring with soul fire; spikes down the spine and a jagged tail; a heavy skull with huge chipped horns sweeping forward, a scowling brow over full round eye sockets burning with soul fire, a cracked jaw and fangs; hooves like split stone. A saddle the renderer can hide, a rider seat locator, and transparent horse-armour and blackstone-plate shells that the armour textures paint. Minecraft pixel units, density 2: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
